_what_this_is: Copy this to tests/replay/<job>/provenance.json when you freeze a summary.json. Every field is required and the suite fails without it: a frozen record with no provenance is an unlabelled number, and 'the run the estimator signed off' looks identical on disk to 'whichever run last passed'.
accepted_run: the 14:17 pack, 7 Sep — the run reviewed and signed off
accepted_by: name of the estimator who signed it off

accepted_numbers._note: Recorded here for the Windows reconciliation ONLY. The fast replay layer pins structure and never money; these are what the Excel/read-back run checks against.
accepted_numbers.verified_repeat: £33.83 labour / £80.34 unit — a previously verified repeat of the same pack. A run reproducing £80.34 rather than £80.09 is NOT a failure on that ground alone.

notes: Anything a reader would otherwise have to ask: which GA was used, what the estimator corrected by hand, what was still open at sign-off.
